decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

(Reason.  To accord with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990)

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

(Reason.  In order to safeguard the visual amenity of the area and building)

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

(Reason.  To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission)

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

(Reason.  To protect the amenity and privacy of nearby residents)

Condition : 5 - Before the development hereby permitted commences, the applicant shall investigate the site for landfill gas to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority to ascertain whether gas protection measures are required.  Where measures are required the details shall be submitted to and approved by the LPA.   Or the applicant shall install gas protection measures as a precautionary measure without first investigating the site.  The details of these measures shall be submitted to and approved by the LPA.  All required measures shall be installed before the development is first occupied.Reason: The site is in close proximity to a former landfill site and the Local Planning Authority wishes to ensure that the development does not give rise to any potential risk from landfill gas migration.

Condition : 6 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions the proposal would not result in harm to the appearance of the property or the wider area and would not cause harm to neighbours' living conditions in accordance with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to house
